extra.reason: Audit complete: 58 Gitea issues (#3-#60) filed at git.catlow.cloud/sam/archie-core. 60 raw findings, 59 verified, 58 successfully filed. 8 agents hit session limit at end (webui/workflow/worktree file-phase).
Implemented concurrent SQLite and NATS task dispatch using containers.max_concurrency, with default same-repo serialization and race-tested dispatcher coverage.

Added config.Repo.AllowConcurrent (allow_concurrent toml key) and threaded it through taskDispatcher so opted-in repos skip the default FIFO same-repo serialization while still respecting containers.max_concurrency. Worktrees are already keyed per issue number, so no on-disk collision. Race-tested dispatcher coverage added.

Completed JetStream task dispatch and NATS agent request/reply, including token_env authentication for archied and canonical NATS_URL/NATS_TOKEN propagation to container workers; anonymous local mode remains supported and race-tested.

Added internal/storerpc: core-NATS request/reply RPC so archie-agent can call Store.Update/Transition without direct DB access. archied's Store stays the sole owner; store.Task gained json tags to cross the wire. Not yet wired into daemon.go or workflow.TaskContext — that's archie-core-5zh.4's job once all three RPC proxies exist.
